answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 200 slots on a public trellis, one rung per slot, and each agent bids from one kernel identity that cannot be split. Bids lock for 20 epochs on a crystal-clear board, so shill bids lift the attacker's own clearing price. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards. Forging 1,000 identities means paying 1,000 clearing prices up front, while an honest agent pays only one.
